newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen falling over bank crisis.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen falling over bank crisis.

text.p: Shares on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) may drop further with investors, nervous over news of a banking sector crisis, expected to stay on the sidelines, brokers said.

"The small investors may rush for selling their scrips after the central bank governor's statement on Tuesday that the banking system is on the verge of collapse due to huge outstanding loans," said Golam Sarwar of Mahbub Morshed & Company.
The DSE bench mark index closed 57.98 points or 5.21 percent down at 1,054.07 on a turnover of 40.5 million taka on Wednesday.
